title: Audit enrichment for RBAC v2: compact diff+actor confidence with SAML context
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Goal: define and implement an enriched audit event shape and taxonomy for RBAC v2 that preserves compact delta encoding for admin actions while adding actor confidence scores (SAML/SSO signal), resolved target identity, and contextual SAML assertions. This ticket scopes the schema, encoding rules, migration path, storage sizing, and observability hooks.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New audit envelope supports compact diffs for policy changes and preserves a stable, backward-compatible top-level envelope. 2) Actor identity resolution fields (resolved_user_id, auth_source, saml_assertion_ref) are present and populated when available. 3) Actor confidence (enum: high|medium|low|unknown) is emitted based on SAML/SSO signals and local heuristics. 4) Target/resource canonicalization included (type, id, pre_change_snapshot_ref). 5) Storage size increase <= 25% for typical admin change event traffic. 6) All fields documented and compatibility shim provided for downstream consumers. 7) Security review completed and PRD + schema published to Confluence.
decision_log: 2025-11-06: Chose compact delta encoding (field-level op: add/remove/replace) instead of full JSON patch to keep event sizes small. 2025-11-08: Include actor_confidence as a four-value enum (high/medium/low/unknown) rather than continuous score to simplify downstream queries and SLOs. 2025-11-10: Opted to reference SAML assertions by stable hash (saml_assertion_ref) instead of embedding full assertion to avoid PII exposure and reduce event size; full assertion stored separately in restricted store if needed.
implementation_notes: - Schema changes limited to top-level 'audit_envelope_v2' with version tag. - Delta format: list of change-frames {field_path, op, old_hash, new_hash} encoded as compact strings. - Actor resolution pipeline will enrich incoming events with: resolved_user_id, auth_source (sso|local|api-key), saml_assertion_ref (sha256), actor_confidence. - If saml_assertion_ref present, attach saml_context_flags (list) such as [email_verified, idp_cert_valid, session_age_lt_24h] as short tokens. - Redaction: drop any raw SAML assertion from event; only references allowed. - Sampling: high-volume non-admin events sampled at 1% by default; admin-level changes and RBAC policy mutations are never sampled. - Backfill: provide translator microservice to convert v1 envelope consumers to v2 shape for 90 days post-release.
storage_estimates: Based on 30k admin events/day baseline: current avg size 1.1KB/event -> projected v2 avg 1.35KB/event (~22% increase). Estimated additional storage 7.5GB/month. Hot path index fields limited to 4 keys to control indexing cost.
migration_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Publish schema and conformance tests; deploy enrichment pipeline in shadow mode. Phase 2 (1 week): Enable live enrichment for admin routes behind feature flag; collect metrics. Phase 3 (1 week): Flip default for RBAC mutation endpoints; monitor error budget and storage. Phase 4 (rollback window 2 weeks): Deprecate v1 consumers and remove translation shim after consumer migration.
risks_and_mitigations: - Risk: Downstream consumers fail on unknown fields -> mitigation: versioned envelope and translation shim. - Risk: Event size growth -> mitigation: compact diff encoding and assertion refs. - Risk: SAML assertion leakage -> mitigation: never embed full assertion, use ref and restricted store. - Risk: Incorrect actor confidence logic causing false positives -> mitigation: add telemetry, expose confidence provenance, and require security review.
qa_checks: - Unit tests for diff encoder/decoder, roundtrip property. - Integration tests for enrichment pipeline with SAML mock responses. - Performance test to validate <5ms p99 overhead on API write path. - End-to-end test verifying translation shim produces v1-compatible payloads.
